name: Racer
author: Claudio Mattera
description: A pseudo-3D racing game: speed down a winding desert road past the cacti, with a speedometer and a track map on screen.

descriptions.en: A pseudo-3D racing game: speed down a winding desert road past the cacti, with a speedometer and a track map on screen.
descriptions.it: Un gioco di corse in pseudo-3D: sfreccia su una strada tortuosa nel deserto tra i cactus, con tachimetro e mappa del circuito sullo schermo.
